instructions: Build ALL THREE carried candidates per the blueprint; return every field with units, method, condition and deviations. Blank fields fail-close (ABSENT). Each measurement maps to the engine parameter it updates (see 'updates').

screen.purpose: compatibility, gel/phase split, fast solids/VOC/KU check

bench.purpose: drawdown, sprayability, pot life, adhesion/corrosion panels

kit.purpose: packaging, mix-volume, spray handling, retained samples

panel_prep.soluble_salts: record method and result before coating
panel_prep.substrate: carbon steel panels with heat/lot recorded

environmental_controls.ambient_temp_f: record at prep, mix, application, cure
environmental_controls.relative_humidity_pct: [ASSUMED confidence=LOW commissioned measurement: RH-vs-blister/holiday sensitivity bench trial to set an explicit numeric ceiling, cf-tier-crosswalk.v1.json#process_parameter:relative_humidity_pct] record at prep, application, cure
environmental_controls.substrate_temp_f: record and maintain >=5F above dew point
environmental_controls.dew_point_f: record computed or measured dew point
environmental_controls.material_temp_f: record Part A, Part B, mixed material

application.application_method: [MODELED confidence=MEDIUM commissioned measurement: application-method comparability trial confirming DFT/WFT/appearance parity across methods, cf-tier-crosswalk.v1.json#process_parameter:application_method] drawdown, airless spray, brush, or roller
application.dft_mils: target 4.5-6.0 [MEASURED confidence=HIGH; envelope + SSPC-PA 2 method]; record per SSPC-PA 2 style grid
application.spray_setup: tip, pressure, hose length, filter, thinner addition if any
application.dry_to_touch_h: target 2 (envelope functional target, distinct from MIL 3 h set-to-touch); record actual
application.mix_ratio_tolerance_pct: 3% engine tolerance band on the nominal 1:1-by-volume A:B mix ratio; record actual mixed ratio
application.thinning_limit_pct_by_volume: do not exceed 5% thinner by volume (naphtha/n-butanol letdown solvent), consistent with the VOC design-to ceiling of 320 g/L against the 340 g/L maximum; record actual thinner addition

controls.positive_control: Lineage-60 public MIL F160/F161 reconstruction; run only after exact ingredient lots, current SDS/TDS/CoA review, lab acceptance, and chain of custody are confirmed
controls.negative_control: uncoated blasted steel witness panel where method permits
controls.reference_panel: commercial QPL-listed Type-IV reference panel only if current product lot, SDS/TDS, QPL status, acquisition path, and chain of custody are confirmed
controls.control_acceptance: if controls fail or deviate materially, the corrosion arm is REVIEW/REPEAT, not a pass

randomization.blind_track_codes: CRO assigns blind A/B/C/D codes after receiving batch IDs
randomization.blocking: randomize by corrosion arm, substrate lot, panel position, and chamber/rack position

panel_counts.panel_count_rule: 6 panels/track/arm is the default quote request; 3 is only the minimum floor

returned_file_schema.b117_1000h: panel photos at intake, interval checks, final; D1654 rating sheet; chamber log
returned_file_schema.cyclic_d5894: cycle log, interval photos, final D1654/rust/blister ratings
returned_file_schema.immersion_d870: immersion bath log, blister rating sheet, final photos
returned_file_schema.adhesion_mpa: pull-off raw force/fixture file, failure mode photos, dolly map
returned_file_schema.opacity_d2805: contrast-ratio drawdown readings and photos for black/yellow twins
returned_file_schema.method24: volatile, water, density, weight-solids, volume-solids worksheets

early_kill_gates.target: no gel, seed, phase split, or irreversible incompatibility before application
early_kill_gates.method: visual check plus KU trend during induction and first 90 min
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: repeat/review if control invalid; otherwise stop or reformulate on confirmed incompatibility
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: repeat/review if control invalid; otherwise stop or reformulate on confirmed incompatibility

early_kill_gates.kill_if: mixed material fails 90 min sprayable/KU window at 73F
early_kill_gates.target: sprayable mixed material at 73F for >=90 min
early_kill_gates.method: ASTM D562 KU-vs-time at 65/73/95F plus application observation
early_kill_gates.tolerance: no severe KU spike, gel, phase split, or unapproved thinning
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: repeat/review on control failure or noisy tie; stop/reformulate if valid sample fails
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: repeat/review on control failure or noisy tie; stop/reformulate if valid sample fails

early_kill_gates.stop_rule: inconclusive if worksheet missing; stop/reformulate if valid value exceeds target
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: inconclusive if worksheet missing; stop/reformulate if valid value exceeds target

early_kill_gates.method: ASTM D2697 or lab-accepted Method 24 solids worksheet
early_kill_gates.tolerance: replicates must not straddle boundary without pre-registered call
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: inconclusive if raw replicates/worksheet missing; stop/reformulate if valid value outside range
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: inconclusive if raw replicates/worksheet missing; stop/reformulate if valid value outside range

early_kill_gates.kill_if: severe sag, pinhole, solvent pop, cratering, or non-wetting at target WFT
early_kill_gates.target: target film can be applied without severe sag/pinhole/crater/solvent pop
early_kill_gates.method: drawdown + airless spray observation, ASTM D4400/D1210
early_kill_gates.tolerance: no severe defects preventing valid corrosion panels
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: inconclusive if setup missing; stop/reformulate if valid application collapses
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: inconclusive if setup missing; stop/reformulate if valid application collapses

early_kill_gates.kill_if: pull-off or immersion adhesion misses acceptance basis
early_kill_gates.target: adhesion meets pre-registered acceptance or control-normalized margin
early_kill_gates.numeric_target: >=20% margin vs threshold/control basis where specified
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: repeat/review on adhesive failure or control failure; stop on valid adhesion miss
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: repeat/review on adhesive failure or control failure; stop on valid adhesion miss

early_kill_gates.kill_if: early blistering, rust creep, or EIS collapse relative to controls
early_kill_gates.target: no early blistering/rust/EIS collapse relative to controls
early_kill_gates.method: ASTM B117/D1654, ASTM D870, ISO 16773 EIS
early_kill_gates.numeric_target: no tied/noisy decisive pair; EIS gap target >=1.0 log10 |Z| where used
early_kill_gates.stop_rule: controls fail -> repeat/review, not pass; tied/noisy decisive pair -> no model promotion
early_kill_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_rule: controls fail -> repeat/review, not pass; tied/noisy decisive pair -> no model promotion

statistical_decision_rules.primary: PASS only if the measured immersion rank has Kendall tau >= 0.5 with the LOCKED rank AND a strictly higher tau than BOTH hostile nulls (solids-only, PVC-only).
statistical_decision_rules.key_pairwise: the Enhanced-65 > Envelope-65 non-obvious call must hold in the measured data (the single most decisive, PVC-contrarian bet).
statistical_decision_rules.tie_rule: two tracks are TIED if their |Z|@0.01Hz overlap within replicate scatter (6 panels/track/arm default if budget allows; 3 panels/track/arm minimum floor); ties are excluded from tau, not narrated as agreement.
statistical_decision_rules.power_caveat: n=4 rank has low power; the decisive, adequately-powered test is the key pairwise bet above, not the full 4-item correlation -- stated honestly, not oversold.

minimum_detectable_effect.eis_log10_abs_z_0p01hz: target detectable difference >=1.0 log10 ohm-cm2 and greater than within-track replicate scatter
minimum_detectable_effect.scribe_creep_mm: target detectable difference >=2 mm and greater than within-track replicate scatter
minimum_detectable_effect.d1654_rating: target detectable difference >=1 rating unit with no control failure
minimum_detectable_effect.adhesion_mpa: target detectable difference >=20% versus control or pre-registered acceptance threshold

statistical_decision_rules.replicate_scatter_threshold: pre-register replicate scatter per arm from 6 panels/track/arm by default, with 3 only as the minimum floor; tracks whose intervals overlap are tied and excluded from tau, not counted as agreement
statistical_decision_rules.inconclusive_outcome: INCONCLUSIVE if controls fail, randomization is broken, the key pairwise call is tied, replicate scatter masks the ordering, or the locked rank does not beat both nulls.

supplier_declaration_template.rendering_rule: render unknown / RFQ required until a signed supplier declaration or current SDS/TDS/CoA is attached

ku_vs_time_3temps.method: ASTM D562 Stormer at 65/73/95F, 30-min intervals to 2x initial KU
ku_vs_time_3temps.updates: cure model refit (Arrhenius) -- WEEK-1 GATE before full battery

density_lb_gal.condition: Part A, Part B, and mixed

viscosity_ku.condition: Part A, Part B, and mixed at 25C

fineness_hegman.condition: post-grind Part A and Part B

dry_times_h.method: ASTM D5895/D1640 (set-to-touch, dry-hard, recoat@6h intercoat check)

adhesion_mpa.method: ASTM D4541 on SP-10 near-white blast, 2.5-3.5 mil profile

b117_1000h.updates: comparative corrosion screen across carry-3 only; not a standalone natural-environment predictor

eis_immersion.updates: corrosion decision with raw spectra/time series

storage_d1849.condition: sealed Part A and Part B retains

batch_record: ingredient lots + measured EEW/amine-value where retested

decision_experiment.purpose: fund a controlled corrosion/pot-life decision experiment, not a trusted corrosion ranking
decision_experiment.commercial_qpl_reference: required if obtainable; record product, lot, QPL listing evidence, and acquisition path
decision_experiment.minimum_design: all tracks built, applied, randomized, and exposed under one CRO protocol with raw data returned

reference_controls.lineage_60: mandatory public-lineage control in every corrosion arm only after exact ingredient lots, current SDS/TDS/CoA review, lab acceptance, and chain of custody are confirmed
reference_controls.commercial_qpl_reference: required if obtainable; use only with current product lot, SDS/TDS, QPL evidence, acquisition path, and chain of custody; otherwise document unavailable
reference_controls.commercial_reference_status_rule: unknown / RFQ required until exact product, lot, QPL listing, SDS/TDS and acquisition path are attached
reference_controls.negative_control: uncoated blasted steel witness panel where method permits

acceptance_gates.method: ASTM D562 KU-vs-time at 65/73/95F plus application observation
acceptance_gates.accept_if: mixed material remains sprayable for >=90 min at 73F with no gel, phase split, severe viscosity spike, or unapproved thinning
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: controls invalid, replicate scatter masks the 90-min call, or lab deviates from temperature/mix protocol

acceptance_gates.accept_if: measured mixed VOC <=340 g/L with lab worksheet returned
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: worksheet missing, replicate inconsistency unresolved, or Method 24 deviation unapproved

acceptance_gates.method: ASTM D2697 or lab-accepted Method 24 solids worksheet
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: replicates straddle the acceptance boundary without a pre-registered call

acceptance_gates.method: drawdown + airless spray observation, ASTM D562/D4400/D1210
acceptance_gates.accept_if: Hegman >=6, target WFT/DFT achievable, sag >=12 mil target, no severe pinhole/crater/solvent pop
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: application defects prevent valid corrosion panels or setup is not recorded

acceptance_gates.accept_if: >=20% margin versus pre-registered acceptance threshold or control-normalized basis, with failure mode recorded
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: adhesive failure invalidates the reading or controls fail

acceptance_gates.accept_if: key Enhanced-65 vs Envelope-65 pairwise gap >=1.0 log10 |Z|@0.01Hz and greater than replicate scatter
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: key pairwise result ties, spectra are missing, controls fail, or scatter overlaps

acceptance_gates.method: ASTM B117 exposure plus ASTM D1654 rating
acceptance_gates.accept_if: scribe creep and D1654 rating meet pre-registered threshold and key pairwise call is not tied
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: control failure, chamber deviation, or overlapping scatter prevents a call

acceptance_gates.accept_if: no control failure and candidate ranking does not contradict the decisive pairwise call
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: cycle logs missing, controls fail, or rank is tied within scatter

acceptance_gates.method: ASTM D870 immersion plus blister/rust/photo record
acceptance_gates.accept_if: no early blistering/rust collapse and EIS/B117 decision remains interpretable
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: bath condition invalid, controls fail, or candidate separation is not interpretable

acceptance_gates.method: ASTM D1849 accelerated storage plus D869 settling on retained Part A and Part B
acceptance_gates.accept_if: no hard settle, gel, skinning, irreversible viscosity drift, or density/KU drift outside pre-registered limits
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: retains not sealed/identified or storage conditions missing

acceptance_gates.accept_if: every result includes method, unit, condition, replicate count, deviation code, raw_value, pass_fail, raw_file_path, and attachment_path
acceptance_gates.fail_or_inconclusive_if: missing raw data, broken blind map, unapproved deviation, or missing calibration record

conditions: replicate scatter overlaps the decisive Enhanced-65 vs Envelope-65 pairwise result
blind randomization or chain of custody is broken
inconclusive_handling.rule: inconclusive is not success; repeat, reformulate, or stop before customer-facing qualification language

explicit_decision_outcomes.controls_fail: repeat/review; never treat candidate data as pass
explicit_decision_outcomes.lineage_60_wins_all_65_fail: do not qualify 65%; use Lineage-60 path if otherwise obtainable
explicit_decision_outcomes.noisy_or_tied_decisive_pair: no model promotion; collect more data or reformulate
